attribution.title: Marble Palace- Kolkata- West Bengal- DSC 0006
attribution.author: Souvik pal
attribution.description: Marble Palace is a palatial nineteenth-century mansion in North Kolkata. It is located at 46, Muktaram Babu Street, Kolkata 700007. It is one of the best-preserved and most elegant houses of nineteenth-century Calcutta.[1] The mansion is famous for its marble walls, floors, and sculptures, from which it derives its name.
